message.content:
This document is a technical README and set of engineering notes for **Project Maya**, a system for running large open-weight language models (GLM-5.3-Flash, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, MiniMax-M3.1-Flash) locally on consumer and prosumer hardware. Here are its key technical points:

## Core System
- **Purpose:** Run very large MoE models (up to ~748B params) on a single PC or small multi-GPU setup, using a mix of VRAM, RAM, and NVMe SSD for expert weights.
